title: Features & Benefits: overview film
description: Ways to explain what you offer. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 32 seconds: the 25 Features & Benefits elements of Desiderio for TYPO3 v14, including bento grid, alternating rows, feature tabs, feature stats, feature cards, comparison. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: A feature list in plain bullet points makes every product sound the same.
Features and Benefits has 25 ways to explain what you offer.
Bento grids, alternating rows, tabs, numbers, cards and comparisons.
Every layout has a backend preview, so editors see the result before they save.
